question: Why does the paper conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811, given how much lithium it leaches?
rendered: The paper does not conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811 due to lithium leaching. Instead, it states that Ni-rich NMC 811 shows only minimal Li^þ leaching (~3 wt%) after one week, which is still a concern but not a showstopper. The authors note that the capacity retention of the aqueous-processed cells is slightly lower than the NMP-processed cells (~70% vs. ~76%), but still demonstrates very good cycling performance.
